versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֥עַן אִיּ֗וֹב וַיֹּאמַֽר׃

controles.web: Then Job answered,
controles.kjv: Then Job answered and said,
controles.livre: Mas Jó respondeu, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: אָ֭מְנָם יָדַ֣עְתִּי כִי־כֵ֑ן וּמַה־יִּצְדַּ֖ק אֱנ֣וֹשׁ עִם־אֵֽל׃

controles.web: “Truly I know that it is so, but how can man be just with God?
controles.kjv: I know it is so of a truth: but how should man be just with God?
controles.livre: Na verdade sei que é assim; mas como pode o ser humano ser justo diante de Deus?

versos.hebraico: אִם־יַ֭חְפֹּץ לָרִ֣יב עִמּ֑וֹ לֹֽא־יַ֝עֲנֶ֗נּוּ אַחַ֥ת מִנִּי־אָֽלֶף׃

controles.web: If he is pleased to contend with him, he can’t answer him one time in a thousand.
controles.kjv: If he will contend with him, he cannot answer him one of a thousand.
controles.livre: Ainda se quisesse disputar com ele, não conseguiria lhe responder uma coisa sequer em mil.

versos.hebraico: חֲכַ֣ם לֵ֭בָב וְאַמִּ֣יץ כֹּ֑חַ מִֽי־הִקְשָׁ֥ה אֵ֝לָ֗יו וַיִּשְׁלָֽם׃

controles.web: God who is wise in heart, and mighty in strength: who has hardened himself against him, and prospered?
controles.kjv: He is wise in heart, and mighty in strength: who hath hardened himself against him, and hath prospered?
controles.livre: Ele é sábio de coração, e poderoso em forças. Quem se endureceu contra ele, e teve paz?

versos.hebraico: הַמַּעְתִּ֣יק הָ֭רִים וְלֹ֣א יָדָ֑עוּ אֲשֶׁ֖ר הֲפָכָ֣ם בְּאַפּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: He removes the mountains, and they don’t know it, when he overturns them in his anger.
controles.kjv: Which removeth the mountains, and they know not: which overturneth them in his anger.
controles.livre: Ele transporta as montanhas sem que o saibam; e as transtorna em seu furor.

versos.hebraico: הַמַּרְגִּ֣יז אֶ֭רֶץ מִמְּקוֹמָ֑הּ וְ֝עַמּוּדֶ֗יהָ יִתְפַלָּצֽוּן׃

controles.web: He shakes the earth out of its place. Its pillars tremble.
controles.kjv: Which shaketh the earth out of her place, and the pillars thereof tremble.
controles.livre: Ele remove a terra de seu lugar, e faz suas colunas tremerem.

versos.hebraico: הָאֹמֵ֣ר לַ֭חֶרֶס וְלֹ֣א יִזְרָ֑ח וּבְעַ֖ד כּוֹכָבִ֣ים יַחְתֹּֽם׃

controles.web: He commands the sun, and it doesn’t rise, and seals up the stars.
controles.kjv: Which commandeth the sun, and it riseth not; and sealeth up the stars.
controles.livre: Ele dá ordem ao sol, e ele não brilha; e sela as estrelas.

versos.hebraico: נֹטֶ֣ה שָׁמַ֣יִם לְבַדּ֑וֹ וְ֝דוֹרֵ֗ךְ עַל־בָּ֥מֳתֵי יָֽם׃

controles.web: He alone stretches out the heavens, and treads on the waves of the sea.
controles.kjv: Which alone spreadeth out the heavens, and treadeth upon the waves of the sea.
controles.livre: Ele é o que sozinho estende os céus, e anda sobre as alturas do mar.

versos.hebraico: עֹֽשֶׂה־עָ֭שׁ כְּסִ֥יל וְכִימָ֗ה וְחַדְרֵ֥י תֵמָֽן׃

controles.web: He makes the Bear, Orion, and the Pleiades, and the rooms of the south.
controles.kjv: Which maketh Arcturus, Orion, and Pleiades, and the chambers of the south.
controles.livre: Ele é o que fez a Usra, o Órion, as Plêiades, e as constelações  do sul.

versos.hebraico: עֹשֶׂ֣ה גְ֭דֹלוֹת עַד־אֵ֣ין חֵ֑קֶר וְנִפְלָא֗וֹת עַד־אֵ֥ין מִסְפָּֽר׃

controles.web: He does great things past finding out; yes, marvelous things without number.
controles.kjv: Which doeth great things past finding out; yea, and wonders without number.
controles.livre: Ele é o que faz coisas grandes e incompreensíveis, e inúmeras maravilhas.

versos.hebraico: הֵ֤ן יַעֲבֹ֣ר עָ֭לַי וְלֹ֣א אֶרְאֶ֑ה וְ֝יַחֲלֹ֗ף וְֽלֹא־אָבִ֥ין לֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Behold, he goes by me, and I don’t see him. He passes on also, but I don’t perceive him.
controles.kjv: Lo, he goeth by me, and I see him not: he passeth on also, but I perceive him not.
controles.livre: Eis que ele passa diante de mim, sem que eu não o veja; ele passará diante de mim, sem que eu saiba.

versos.hebraico: הֵ֣ן יַ֭חְתֹּף מִ֣י יְשִׁיבֶ֑נּוּ מִֽי־יֹאמַ֥ר אֵ֝לָ֗יו מַֽה־תַּעֲשֶֽׂה׃

controles.web: Behold, he snatches away. Who can hinder him? Who will ask him, ‘What are you doing?’
controles.kjv: Behold, he taketh away, who can hinder him? who will say unto him, What doest thou?
controles.livre: Eis que, quando ele toma, quem pode lhe impedir? Quem poderá lhe dizer: O que estás fazendo?

versos.hebraico: אֱ֭לוֹהַּ לֹא־יָשִׁ֣יב אַפּ֑וֹ תחתו שָׁ֝חֲח֗וּ עֹ֣זְרֵי רָֽהַב׃

controles.web: “God will not withdraw his anger. The helpers of Rahab stoop under him.
controles.kjv: If God will not withdraw his anger, the proud helpers do stoop under him.
controles.livre: Deus não reverterá sua ira, e debaixo dele se encurvam os assistentes de Raabe.

versos.hebraico: אַ֭ף כִּֽי־אָנֹכִ֣י אֶֽעֱנֶ֑נּוּ אֶבְחֲרָ֖ה דְבָרַ֣י עִמּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: How much less shall I answer him, And choose my words to argue with him?
controles.kjv: How much less shall I answer him, and choose out my words to reason with him?
controles.livre: Como poderia eu lhe responder, e escolher minhas palavras contra ele?

versos.hebraico: אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִם־צָ֭דַקְתִּי לֹ֣א אֶעֱנֶ֑ה לִ֝מְשֹׁפְטִ֗י אֶתְחַנָּֽן׃

controles.web: Though I were righteous, yet I wouldn’t answer him. I would make supplication to my judge.
controles.kjv: Whom, though I were righteous, yet would I not answer, but I would make supplication to my judge.
controles.livre: A ele, ainda que eu fosse justo, não lhe responderia; a meu juiz pediria misericórdia.

versos.hebraico: אִם־קָרָ֥אתִי וַֽיַּעֲנֵ֑נִי לֹֽא־אַ֝אֲמִ֗ין כִּֽי־יַאֲזִ֥ין קוֹלִֽי׃

controles.web: If I had called, and he had answered me, yet I wouldn’t believe that he listened to my voice.
controles.kjv: If I had called, and he had answered me; yet would I not believe that he had hearkened unto my voice.
controles.livre: Ainda que eu lhe chamasse, e ele respondesse, mesmo assim não creria que ele tivesse dado ouvidos à minha voz.

versos.hebraico: אֲשֶׁר־בִּשְׂעָרָ֥ה יְשׁוּפֵ֑נִי וְהִרְבָּ֖ה פְצָעַ֣י חִנָּֽם׃

controles.web: For he breaks me with a storm, and multiplies my wounds without cause.
controles.kjv: For he breaketh me with a tempest, and multiplieth my wounds without cause.
controles.livre: Pois ele tem me quebrantado com tempestade, e multiplicado minhas feridas sem causa.

versos.hebraico: לֹֽא־יִ֭תְּנֵנִי הָשֵׁ֣ב רוּחִ֑י כִּ֥י יַ֝שְׂבִּעַ֗נִי מַמְּרֹרִֽים׃

controles.web: He will not allow me to catch my breath, but fills me with bitterness.
controles.kjv: He will not suffer me to take my breath, but filleth me with bitterness.
controles.livre: Ele não me permite respirar; em vez disso, me farta de amarguras.

versos.hebraico: אִם־לְכֹ֣חַ אַמִּ֣יץ הִנֵּ֑ה וְאִם־לְ֝מִשְׁפָּ֗ט מִ֣י יוֹעִידֵֽנִי׃

controles.web: If it is a matter of strength, behold, he is mighty! If of justice, ‘Who,’ says he, ‘will summon me?’
controles.kjv: If I speak of strength, lo, he is strong: and if of judgment, who shall set me a time to plead?
controles.livre: Quanto às forças, eis que ele é forte; e quanto ao juízo, ele diria : Quem me convocará?

versos.hebraico: אִם־אֶ֭צְדָּק פִּ֣י יַרְשִׁיעֵ֑נִי תָּֽם־אָ֝֗נִי וַֽיַּעְקְשֵֽׁנִי׃

controles.web: Though I am righteous, my own mouth shall condemn me. Though I am blameless, it shall prove me perverse.
controles.kjv: If I justify myself, mine own mouth shall condemn me: if I say, I am perfect, it shall also prove me perverse.
controles.livre: Ainda que eu seja justo, minha boca me condenaria; se eu fosse inocente, então ela me declararia perverso.

versos.hebraico: תָּֽם־אָ֭נִי לֹֽא־אֵדַ֥ע נַפְשִׁ֗י אֶמְאַ֥ס חַיָּֽי׃

controles.web: I am blameless. I don’t respect myself. I despise my life.
controles.kjv: Though I were perfect, yet would I not know my soul: I would despise my life.
controles.livre: Mesmo se eu for inocente, não estimo minha alma; desprezo minha vida.

versos.hebraico: אַחַ֗ת הִ֥יא עַל־כֵּ֥ן אָמַ֑רְתִּי תָּ֥ם וְ֝רָשָׁ֗ע ה֣וּא מְכַלֶּֽה׃

controles.web: “It is all the same. Therefore I say he destroys the blameless and the wicked.
controles.kjv: This is one thing, therefore I said it, He destroyeth the perfect and the wicked.
controles.livre: É tudo a mesma coisa; por isso digo: ele consome ao inocente e ao perverso.

versos.hebraico: אִם־שׁ֭וֹט יָמִ֣ית פִּתְאֹ֑ם לְמַסַּ֖ת נְקִיִּ֣ם יִלְעָֽג׃

controles.web: If the scourge kills suddenly, he will mock at the trial of the innocent.
controles.kjv: If the scourge slay suddenly, he will laugh at the trial of the innocent.
controles.livre: Quando o açoite mata de repente, ele ri do desespero dos inocentes.

versos.hebraico: אֶ֤רֶץ׀ נִתְּנָ֬ה בְֽיַד־רָשָׁ֗ע פְּנֵֽי־שֹׁפְטֶ֥יהָ יְכַסֶּ֑ה אִם־לֹ֖א אֵפ֣וֹא מִי־הֽוּא׃

controles.web: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked. He covers the faces of its judges. If not he, then who is it?
controles.kjv: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked: he covereth the faces of the judges thereof; if not, where, and who is he?
controles.livre: A terra está entregue nas mãos dos perversos. Ele cobre o rosto de seus juízes. Se não é ele, então quem é?

versos.hebraico: וְיָמַ֣י קַ֭לּוּ מִנִּי־רָ֑ץ בָּֽ֝רְח֗וּ לֹא־רָא֥וּ טוֹבָֽה׃

controles.web: “Now my days are swifter than a runner. They flee away, they see no good,
controles.kjv: Now my days are swifter than a post: they flee away, they see no good.
controles.livre: Meus dias foram mais rápidos que um homem que corre; fugiram, e não viram o bem.

versos.hebraico: חָ֭לְפוּ עִם־אֳנִיּ֣וֹת אֵבֶ֑ה כְּ֝נֶ֗שֶׁר יָט֥וּשׂ עֲלֵי־אֹֽכֶל׃

controles.web: They have passed away as the swift ships, as the eagle that swoops on the prey.
controles.kjv: They are passed away as the swift ships: as the eagle that hasteth to the prey.
controles.livre: Passaram como barcos de papiro, como a águia que se lança à comida.

versos.hebraico: אִם־אָ֭מְרִי אֶשְׁכְּחָ֣ה שִׂיחִ֑י אֶעֶזְבָ֖ה פָנַ֣י וְאַבְלִֽיגָה׃

controles.web: If I say, ‘I will forget my complaint, I will put off my sad face, and cheer up;’
controles.kjv: If I say, I will forget my complaint, I will leave off my heaviness, and comfort myself:
controles.livre: Se disser: Esquecerei minha queixa, mudarei o aspecto do meu rosto, e sorrirei,

versos.hebraico: יָגֹ֥רְתִּי כָל־עַצְּבֹתָ֑י יָ֝דַ֗עְתִּי כִּי־לֹ֥א תְנַקֵּֽנִי׃

controles.web: I am afraid of all my sorrows, I know that you will not hold me innocent.
controles.kjv: I am afraid of all my sorrows, I know that thou wilt not hold me innocent.
controles.livre: Ainda teria pavor de todas as minhas dores; pois sei que não me terás por inocente.

versos.hebraico: אָנֹכִ֥י אֶרְשָׁ֑ע לָמָּה־זֶּ֝֗ה הֶ֣בֶל אִיגָֽע׃

controles.web: I shall be condemned. Why then do I labor in vain?
controles.kjv: If I be wicked, why then labour I in vain?
controles.livre: Se eu já estou condenado, então para que eu sofreria em vão?

versos.hebraico: אִם־הִתְרָחַ֥צְתִּי במו־שָׁ֑לֶג וַ֝הֲזִכּ֗וֹתִי בְּבֹ֣ר כַּפָּֽי׃

controles.web: If I wash myself with snow, and cleanse my hands with lye,
controles.kjv: If I wash myself with snow water, and make my hands never so clean;
controles.livre: Ainda que me lave com água de neve, e limpe minhas mãos com sabão,

versos.hebraico: אָ֭ז בַּשַּׁ֣חַת תִּטְבְּלֵ֑נִי וְ֝תִֽעֲב֗וּנִי שַׂלְמוֹתָֽי׃

controles.web: yet you will plunge me in the ditch. My own clothes shall abhor me.
controles.kjv: Yet shalt thou plunge me in the ditch, and mine own clothes shall abhor me.
controles.livre: Então me submergirias no fosso, e minhas próprias vestes me abominariam.

versos.hebraico: כִּי־לֹא־אִ֣ישׁ כָּמֹ֣נִי אֶֽעֱנֶ֑נּוּ נָב֥וֹא יַ֝חְדָּ֗ו בַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃

controles.web: For he is not a man, as I am, that I should answer him, that we should come together in judgment.
controles.kjv: For he is not a man, as I am, that I should answer him, and we should come together in judgment.
controles.livre: Pois ele não é homem como eu, para que eu lhe responda, e venhamos juntamente a juízo.

versos.hebraico: לֹ֣א יֵשׁ־בֵּינֵ֣ינוּ מוֹכִ֑יחַ יָשֵׁ֖ת יָד֣וֹ עַל־שְׁנֵֽינוּ׃

controles.web: There is no umpire between us, that might lay his hand on us both.
controles.kjv: Neither is there any daysman betwixt us, that might lay his hand upon us both.
controles.livre: Não há entre nós árbitro que ponha sua mão sobre nós ambos,

versos.hebraico: יָסֵ֣ר מֵעָלַ֣י שִׁבְט֑וֹ וְ֝אֵמָת֗וֹ אַֽל־תְּבַעֲתַֽנִּי׃

controles.web: Let him take his rod away from me. Let his terror not make me afraid;
controles.kjv: Let him take his rod away from me, and let not his fear terrify me:
controles.livre: Tire de sobre mim sua vara, e seu terror não me espante.

versos.hebraico: אַֽ֭דַבְּרָה וְלֹ֣א אִירָאֶ֑נּוּ כִּ֥י לֹא־כֵ֥ן אָ֝נֹכִ֗י עִמָּדִֽי׃

controles.web: then I would speak, and not fear him, for I am not so in myself.
controles.kjv: Then would I speak, and not fear him; but it is not so with me.
controles.livre: Então eu falaria, e não teria medo dele. Pois não está sendo assim comigo.
